title: Cascade Vision Time Limits: Claim Filing, Free Look, Binder, Reinstatement and Age Limits
content:
The time and age limits below apply to the Vision Plans. Days are calendar days and months are calendar months.

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Participating provider must submit a claim within (days after date of service) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Member must submit an out-of-network claim within (days after date of service) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Free-look period (days after the coverage effective date) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Binder premium due within (days after the coverage effective date) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Reinstatement window (days after a nonpayment termination date) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Re-enrollment lockout after a voluntary termination (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Dependent child enrollment ends at the end of the month of birthday | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 |
| An individual enrollment may change plan | next benefit-period start | next benefit-period start | next benefit-period start | next benefit-period start | next benefit-period start | next benefit-period start |

**What each limit means**

- *Claim filing, participating provider*: calendar days after the date of service within which a participating provider must submit a claim (180).
- *Claim filing, member*: calendar days after the date of service within which a member must submit an out-of-network claim (365).
- *Free look*: calendar days after the coverage effective date within which an individual subscriber may return the plan for a full refund (10).
- *Binder*: calendar days after the coverage effective date by which the binder premium must be received (30).
- *Reinstatement*: calendar days after a nonpayment termination date within which coverage may be reinstated (30).
- *Re-enrollment lockout*: calendar months after a voluntary termination date during which the same person may not re-enroll in an individual vision plan (12).
- *Dependent child age*: a child's enrollment ends at the end of the month of the 26th birthday.
- *Plan change*: an individual enrollment changes plan only with effect from the next benefit-period start.

The figures are the same on all six plans.
